task: Bounded gameplay fix before the Bomber retry: an already-emitted hostile projectile is independent of its emitter and continues its normal lifecycle after the enemy dies (owner decision 2026-09-17)

root_cause.coupling: spawn_interceptor_breakup_effects (every lethal Raider hit) jumped to begin_enemy_fighter_explosion_with_projectile_cleanup, which freed every hostile PairShot slot whose ACTIVE bit 0 matched ENEMY_TARGET_SLOT. Light Wingman/Interceptor shots are tagged with the leader P1 bit ($06|class<<3), so they also vanished when Raider P1 died. light_destroyed itself never cleared shots.
root_cause.other_paths_checked: No C code (lifecycle.c, director.c) touches projectile slots; capital admission (ordinary_wave_pressure_active, _asm_sector_pressure_active) already waits for released shots to leave naturally; no other reader of FIGHTER_PROJECTILE_INTERCEPTOR_EMITTER_MASK exists.

change.asm: spawn_interceptor_breakup_effects now jumps straight to begin_enemy_fighter_explosion; the 27-B cleanup routine is removed from ENTITY_CODE. A zero-byte label begin_enemy_fighter_explosion_body after the first instruction keeps a trace boundary.
change.owner_bits: Unchanged: ACTIVE still carries emitter/Light tag bits 0-2 and weapon_class << 3 (allocation, ENEMY_WEAPON_CURSOR alternation, tracing).
change.trace: scripts/runtime-wall-trace.mjs maps DFTRACE_PC_EMITTER_CLEANUP to begin_enemy_fighter_explosion_tail and _END to begin_enemy_fighter_explosion_body (no header change, no --prepare); the --raider-remnant-only gate now requires every emitter-owned shot at a kill to continue and none to be removed.

cpu.removed_path: spawn_interceptor_breakup_effects build-harness cost 243 -> 99 cycles per Raider kill (the 5-slot scan is gone)
cpu.added_cost: none in code; orphaned shots now live their full lifetime, so average hostile occupancy rises (bounded by the unchanged 5-slot pool, so the worst case is the already-legal 5 hostile shots)
